correctness.rationale: Every query support on at most nine labels with three queries is checked after a proved restriction-extension reduction (95284 tests and exact identification of 504 exceptional supports). All six-label candidate supports of sizes at most six are exhaustively tested (60460); seven queries require 128 concepts but there are only 120 cycles. Two independent six-label concept-oracle constructions coincide (permutations versus all binary quadrangle equation solutions). Recomputed facet groups, orbits, and 64 witnesses match the embedded certificate.

value.rationale: Exact minimal three-query nonindependence is a natural local-consistency boundary for partial circular orders on arbitrary labels. At six labels the complete nonpure shattering complex has 6421 faces, 2370 facets across sizes 4,5,6, and 10 natural relabeling orbits; these structural data are not entailed by scalar VC dimension alone. The first checked appearance of three facet sizes among n=3..6 motivates this finite threshold, and the universal result has no fixed n limitation.
